description: This file defines the Icon class for creating map marker icons in the Leaflet library, including methods for creating icon and shadow elements, setting styles, and handling icon options.

classes.name: Icon
classes.description: Represents a map marker icon with customizable options such as URL, size, anchor points, and shadow.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Icon instance with provided options.

methods.name: createIcon
methods.description: Creates and returns the HTML element for the icon.

methods.name: createShadow
methods.description: Creates and returns the HTML element for the icon's shadow.

methods.name: _createIcon
methods.description: Internal method to generate icon or shadow element based on name.

methods.name: _setIconStyles
methods.description: Applies size and anchor styles to the icon or shadow element.

methods.name: _createImg
methods.description: Creates an image element with the specified source.

methods.name: _getIconUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate icon URL, considering retina options.
